newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed.

text.p: New York precious metals futures were called to open mixed Thursday, with the bullion market steady overnight.

But a continued rally in the dollar helped push the price of gold in South African rand to a fresh new-nine month low and in Australian dollars to a fresh multi-year low overnight, prompting talk of more producer hedging, traders said.
COMEX April gold was called unchanged to off $0.30 from Wednesday's close of $346.40 an ounce. It traded from $347.10 to $345.50 on ACCESS.
